item.title: Trump diz que Bombardier investirá US$270 milhões nos EUA
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, disse na noite da quinta-feira que a fabricante canadense de jatos Bombardier investirá US$270 milhões nos EUA, dias depois de ter retirado as ameaças de proibir a entrada da empresa no país.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, disse na noite da quinta-feira que a fabricante canadense de jatos Bombardier (BBDb.TO) investirá US$270 milhões nos EUA, dias depois de ter retirado as ameaças de proibir a entrada da empresa no país. As ameaças de Trump contra a Bombardier, feitas em setembro, se tornaram uma questão política no Kansas, onde a empresa emprega 1.500 pessoas em Wichita. A ameaça de proibição gerou ligações para a Casa Branca por parte de parlamentares do Kansas, incluindo o senador republicano Roger Marshall, que enfrenta uma disputa acirrada nas eleições legislativas de meio de mandato de 3 de novembro. A Bombardier vai recrutar para 500 vagas em todo o território dos EUA e planeja criar mais 300 empregos por meio de projetos de expansão, informou a empresa em comunicado nesta sexta-feira. A expansão incluirá um investimento inicial de cerca de US$270 milhões para o desenvolvimento de infraestrutura na primeira fase, segundo o comunicado. “Com base em nossas conversas construtivas com o governo dos EUA, vemos um caminho promissor para nossos trabalhadores aeroespaciais altamente qualificados, bem como um ambiente positivo para a Bombardier continuar buscando investimentos diretos para ampliar nossa presença nos Estados Unidos”, disse o presidente-executivo Eric Martel. As contratações serão distribuídas entre o Texas, o Kansas, o Indiana e Connecticut, informou a empresa. Em uma postagem no Truth Social na noite de quinta-feira, Trump afirmou que o investimento da Bombardier criaria milhares de empregos no Kansas, no Texas e em Indiana, e atribuiu o mérito do acordo a Marshall e ao procurador-geral do Texas, Ken Paxton. A Bombardier, que adquiriu a Learjet e estabeleceu sua sede nos EUA no Kansas em 1990, possui 3.500 postos de trabalho nos EUA, dos quais mais de 40% estão em Wichita. (Reportagem de Devika Nair, Rajveer Singh Pardesi, em Bengaluru; Reportagem adicional de M Angela Christy)

item.title: Apple fans, customers react as iPhone Duo hits stores
item.description: Apple's first folding iPhone, the iPhone Duo, went on sale in stores on Friday, with fans and consumers queueing to get their hands on the new device from Singapore and Shanghai to London and Berlin.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Apple's (AAPL.O) first folding iPhone, the iPhone Duo, went on sale in stores on Friday, with fans and consumers queueing to get their hands on the new device from Singapore and Shanghai to London and Berlin. Early reviews praised the Duo's design and barely visible hinge, but flagged camera compromises, apps not yet adapted to the new display and the device being less handy for quick tasks when folded. Below are comments from some fans and customers: CHARITY MANAGER, PAUL FRANCIS AT THE LONDON STORE: "Well, some people think it was mad. Including myself. I was here from half nine last night in the pouring rain to queue up for, for a new phone. When a new device like a flip phone comes out from Apple, it's something that I'm willing to stand out in the pouring rain for." HEALTHCARE ADMINISTRATOR, PATRICIA ALVES, 29, AT THE LONDON STORE: "I was concerned with the videos with the reviews but it's actually very good ... the pre-order was actually like people said 'a blood bath' but we got it." IPHONE FAN JEROME SCHAEFFER AT THE BERLIN STORE: "The price is relatively high. Many software features aren't available in the EU yet, either... That said, it has turned out to be a very nice piece of hardware." STUDENT, HUGO MARFANI, 21, AT THE LONDON STORE: "It's way thinner than I thought it would be. And it's just really cool to use and fold. It's got such great, satisfying click." IPHONE FAN PATRICK WOLTER AT THE BERLIN STORE: "I've always found it a hassle to carry around a separate tablet ... In the long run, this will likely end up replacing those other (tablet) devices." STUDENT, MARTIN DEMETER, 21, AT THE LONDON STORE: "I wanted to queue because obviously the stock is quite limited. So if I was to wait, I would have to get it in like January. I just really didn't want to wait for January." CHARITY WORKER, CAMERON CUTHBERTSON, 33, AT THE LONDON STORE : "I think the folding phone is the way forward, because it lets you do so much compared to traditional phones." CUSTOMER AND HEALTHCARE INDUSTRY PROFESSIONAL, LIU WEI, 26, AT THE SHANGHAI STORE: "Maybe the first time you see them, they (foldables) seem impressive. But when you use them over time there might be some shortcomings in the software ... so I bought one on launch day to try it out." CUSTOMER AND GAMING INDUSTRY PROFESSIONAL, LUCAS LI, 36, AT THE SHANGHAI STORE: "Now that Apple has entered the market, there's a hope they (foldables) will become mainstream." MALE OFFICE WORKER, 33, WHO WAS CONSIDERING BUYING THE PHONE AT THE TOKYO STORE: "The big screen makes it perfect for watching videos and reading manga."

item.content:encoded: Bundesaußenminister Johann Wadephul setzt angesichts der weitreichenden Folgen der Kriege im Nahen Osten und in der Ukraine auf Diplomatie über die üblichen Formate hinaus. Auf Initiative Deutschlands und der Türkei trifft der CDU-Politiker am Freitag in Istanbul seine Amtskollegen aus Frankreich, Großbritannien, Italien sowie Ägypten, Pakistan, Saudi-Arabien und der Türkei. "Bei unserem ersten Treffen in diesem Format wollen wir Europäer und die vier Regionalmächte vereint ausloten, wie wir Bewegung in die Konflikte in der Straße von Hormus, am Bab al-Mandab und im Schwarzen Meer bringen können", erklärte Wadephul vor seiner Abreise. Diese massiven Herausforderungen ließen sich nur bewältigen, wenn man über bestehende Strukturen hinaus an einem Strang ziehe. Wadephul verurteilte die Bedrohungen für den Welthandel scharf. "Wir acht setzen gemeinsam ein Zeichen: Wir nehmen nicht hin, dass Iran und die Huthi-Milizen den Welthandel erpressen und die Versorgung der Welt mit Energie und Düngemitteln weiter im Würgegriff halten", sagte er. Die willkürlichen Angriffe auf die freie Schifffahrt und die Nachbarländer müssten enden. Zudem kritisierte der Minister Russland, das den freien Schiffsverkehr im Schwarzen Meer ins Visier genommen habe. Mit Angriffen auf Getreidelieferungen nehme die Regierung in Moskau eine Nahrungsmittelknappheit im globalen Süden wissentlich in Kauf. Die Auswirkungen der Attacken auf die Seewege seien weltweit zu spüren, etwa durch steigende Preise an Tankstellen und in Supermärkten. Der Verband Deutscher Reeder (VDR) begrüßte die diplomatische Initiative. "Deutschland darf bei der Sicherheit der Seewege nicht Zuschauer sein", erklärte VDR-Hauptgeschäftsführer Martin Kröger am Freitag. Als Handelsnation sei die Bundesrepublik auf freie Seerouten angewiesen – sowohl für Exporte als auch für die Versorgung mit Energie, Rohstoffen und Waren. Kröger betonte die Dringlichkeit der Lage: "Wenn Getreide, Düngemittel und Energie nicht zuverlässig ankommen, steht die Versorgung ganzer Regionen auf dem Spiel." Der VDR hatte in der vergangenen Woche verstärkte diplomatische Bemühungen und koordinierte Schutzmaßnahmen gefordert. Nach Angaben des Verbandes prägen knapp 300 Reedereien mit insgesamt 1716 Schiffen die deutsche Handelsschifffahrt.

item.title: Proprietária da Gucci registra queda de 12% enquanto setor de luxo se prepara para um inverno difícil
item.description: As ações da Kering , proprietária da Gucci, despencavam 12% na sexta-feira, depois que o grupo divulgou novas quedas nas vendas, mas afirmou que manteria o plano de recuperação do presidente-executivo Luca de Meo e aceleraria o fechamento de lojas, com a meta de chegar a 125 até o final do ano.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As ações da Kering (PRTP.PA) , proprietária da Gucci, despencavam 12% na sexta-feira, depois que o grupo divulgou novas quedas nas vendas, mas afirmou que manteria o plano de recuperação do presidente-executivo Luca de Meo e aceleraria o fechamento de lojas, com a meta de chegar a 125 até o final do ano. A recuperação há muito prometida pelas marcas de luxo parece não estar à vista, já que a expansão da guerra no Oriente Médio, juntamente com as medidas fiscais da China contra os ricos, exerceram ainda mais pressão sobre os maiores conglomerados de luxo do mundo no terceiro trimestre, e os executivos se prepararam para um inverno difícil. Os distúrbios em Paris, que deixaram as vitrines da Louis Vuitton destruídas e fogueiras com bicicletas elétricas perto da Place Vendôme — meca das compras de luxo —, destacaram com clareza o risco político enfrentado pelas marcas de luxo, não apenas no exterior, mas também em seu próprio país. As ações da LVMH (LVMH.PA) e da Hermès (HRMS.PA) também caíam entre 1% e 1,5% na sexta-feira, à medida que os preços do petróleo atingiram seu nível mais alto desde o início de maio, agravando a pressão sobre as famílias, o que tem restringido a capacidade dos consumidores de gastar com bolsas e roupas. Harsharan Mann, gestora de carteiras de ações globais da Aviva Investors em Londres, afirmou que as marcas de luxo talvez precisem reduzir ainda mais os preços dos produtos básicos para atrair os consumidores de volta. “Se os preços ainda estiverem um pouco fora da realidade ou se o consumidor ainda achar que os preços são altos demais para aceitar, então você pode ter a melhor criatividade, mas será que o consumidor vai se interessar pelo produto?”, disse ela. GUCCI ENFRENTA DIFICULDADES PARA SE RECUPERAR O declínio da Gucci continuou, apesar do plano de de Meo de tornar os preços da marca mais atraentes para os consumidores de classe média e da coleção “Primavera” do diretor criativo Demna — incluindo um vestido justo incrustado de cristais de US$5.900 —, que chegou às lojas em meados de julho. As vendas da Gucci melhoraram no atacado, mas caíram 6% no total. “O progresso alcançado na melhoria da atratividade da marca ainda está em um estágio muito inicial”, afirmou a analista do JPMorgan, Chiara Battistini, em uma nota. O diretor financeiro da Kering disse que a recuperação da marca seria “gradual” e que o baixo fluxo de clientes era o principal desafio, especialmente na China. Enquanto a Kering luta para concretizar uma recuperação em um cenário econômico desfavorável, até mesmo a Hermes, marca de luxo, mostra sinais de desaceleração, com sua divisão de prêt-à-porter registrando queda de 2% no terceiro trimestre devido à fraca demanda chinesa. No geral, a Hermes registrou seu menor crescimento trimestral de vendas desde 2020. (Reportagem de Helen Reid, com contribuição de Alessandro Parodi)

item.content:encoded: Angesichts einer düsteren Prognose für die Metall- und Elektroindustrie hat der Arbeitgeberverband Gesamtmetall die Bundesregierung zu dringenden Reformen bei Steuern, Sozialabgaben und Bürokratie aufgefordert. Besonders scharf kritisierte Hauptgeschäftsführer Oliver Zander am Freitag die Haushaltspolitik von Finanzminister Lars Klingbeil. "Der Klingbeil spart nicht, keinen Pfennig", sagte Zander. Hintergrund ist die Forderung, Unternehmen zu entlasten und Sozialbeiträge zu stabilisieren. Dazu fordert der Verband, dass der Bund Gesundheitskosten von Grundsicherungsempfängern stärker aus Steuermitteln finanziert. Um das Geld dafür aufzubringen, müsse Klingbeil "alles durchgehen und massiv sparen". Anlass ist eine Blitzumfrage des Verbands, der zufolge zwei von fünf Unternehmen der Metall- und Elektroindustrie ihre Geschäftslage als schlecht bewerten. 42 Prozent planen in den nächsten sechs Monaten einen Personalabbau. In den kommenden drei bis fünf Jahren rechneten mehr als 10.000 Betriebe mit einer Schrumpfung, rund 1000 Standorten drohe nach Berechnungen des Verbandes die Schließung. Die Produktion der Branche dürfte 2026 laut Gesamtmetall um weitere zwei Prozent zurückgehen. Damit steuere der Bereich auf ein drittes Rezessionsjahr in Folge zu. Gegenüber 2018 liege die Produktion 15 Prozent niedriger. Im selben Zeitraum seien rund 350.000 Arbeitsplätze verloren gegangen. Derzeit würden in der Branche monatlich rund 10.000 Arbeitsplätze abgebaut. ZANDER: INLANDSAUFTRÄGE GARANTIEREN NICHT INLANDSPRODUKTION Besonders besorgniserregend sei, dass steigende Auftragseingänge immer seltener zu zusätzlicher Produktion in Deutschland führten. Bei 65 Prozent der befragten Betriebe schlügen sich Neuaufträge nicht oder nur teilweise in der heimischen Fertigung nieder. Als häufigsten Grund nannten betroffene Unternehmen die Produktion im Ausland. "Inlandsaufträge bedeuten nicht Inlandsproduktion", sagte Zander. Ausländische Standorte seien wegen geringerer Kosten und besserer Rahmenbedingungen vielfach wirtschaftlicher. Der Verband warnte vor einer Deindustrialisierung. Die Investitionen in Maschinen und Anlagen blieben weit hinter dem früheren Trend zurück. Die daraus errechnete Investitionslücke seit 2020 summiere sich auf rund 65 Milliarden Euro. Arbeitskosten, Energiepreise und Bürokratie seien die größten Investitionshemmnisse. Einzelne Wachstumsbereiche wie die Rüstungsindustrie könnten den Niedergang in der Breite nicht ausgleichen. "So eine Krise hatten wir seit Gründung der Bundesrepublik nicht", sagte Zander. In der mit rund 3,7 Millionen Beschäftigten größten Industriesparte Deutschlands laufen derzeit auch die Verhandlungen mit der IG Metall über einen neuen Flächentarifvertrag. Am Dienstag beginnt die zweite Verhandlungsrunde. Ende Oktober läuft die Friedenspflicht aus, danach sind Warnstreiks möglich. Die Gewerkschaft fordert fünf Prozent mehr Geld bei einer Laufzeit von zwölf Monaten.

item.title: Ministros de la UE se comprometen a enfrentar "China Shock 2.0" mediante conversaciones con Pekín
item.description: La Unión Europea debería alcanzar acuerdos con Pekín para frenar las importaciones en sectores como el químico, el de maquinaria y el farmacéutico, afirmaron el viernes los ministros del bloque, en un momento en que se enfrenta a un déficit comercial de bienes "insostenible" y perjudicial con China.
item.dc:creator: Philip Blenkinsop, Padraic Halpin
item.content:encoded: La Unión Europea debería alcanzar acuerdos con Pekín para frenar las importaciones en sectores como el químico, el de maquinaria y el farmacéutico, afirmaron el viernes los ministros del bloque, en un momento en que se enfrenta a un déficit comercial de bienes "insostenible" y perjudicial con China. El comisario europeo de Comercio, Maros Sefcovic, acordó este mes con Pekín que la UE redujera en más de la mitad las importaciones de vehículos híbridos para hacer frente a un déficit que ha aumentado hasta superar los 1.000 millones de euros (1.120 millones de dólares) al día, y para apoyar a los atribulados fabricantes europeos. La ministra de Relaciones Exteriores irlandesa, Helen McEntee, dijo a la prensa que el diálogo con China podría ser un trampolín "para buscar más industrias y sectores en los que podamos abordar ese desequilibrio". China necesita compradores foráneos para dar salida a la avalancha de productos relativamente baratos y subvencionados por el Estado que sus propios consumidores no pueden absorber, y la UE se debate entre acoger esas importaciones para aliviar el costo de la vida y mantenerlas fuera para reconstruir sus propias fábricas. El déficit comercial de la UE en bienes se disparó hasta superar los 370.000 millones de euros (415.070 millones de dólares) en 2025 y va camino de superar con creces los 400.000 millones de euros este año, una situación que la presidenta de la Comisión Europea, Ursula von der Leyen, ha calificado de "insostenible". La industria europea afirma que el auge de las exportaciones, bautizado como "China Shock 2.0", ya está provocando cierres de fábricas y pérdidas de empleo, sobre todo los 100.000 puestos de trabajo que se prevé que desaparezcan en Volkswagen. China ha afirmado en el pasado que no es la causa principal de los problemas de la UE, sino un socio para resolverlos. Von der Leyen dijo esta semana que existe una creciente preocupación por los productos químicos y la maquinaria. El ministro de Relaciones Exteriores de Lituania, Kestutis Budrys, afirmó el viernes que también podrían incluirse los productos farmacéuticos. (1 dólar = 0,8914 euros)

item.title: Philippine authorities investigate Thomas Markle, father of Meghan, after child sexual abuse images claims
item.description: Authorities in the Philippines are investigating Thomas Markle, father of Meghan, the wife of Britain's Prince Harry, the Philippine justice undersecretary said on Friday, after allegations he possessed child sexual abuse images.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Authorities in the Philippines are investigating Thomas Markle, father of Meghan, the wife of Britain's Prince Harry, the Philippine justice undersecretary said on Friday, after allegations he possessed child sexual abuse images. "Our Anti-Trafficking and Anti-OSAEC (online sexual abuse and exploitation of children) task force in Cebu is currently investigating the matter," Nicholas Ty, Philippine justice undersecretary, told Reuters. Reuters could not immediately reach Thomas Markle for comment but he was quoted by the Daily Mail newspaper in Britain as saying the allegations against him were untrue and "sick lies". Meghan, who married King Charles' younger son and whose royal title is the Duchess of Sussex, said she was "deeply distressed" over the allegations, first published in Britain's the Sun newspaper on Friday. According to the Sun, Meghan's half-brother reported his father to police in the city of Cebu in the Philippines where Thomas Markle had been living, after finding a huge collection of child sexual abuse images in his father's house. Meghan said in a statement she had known about the allegations against her father, 82, since 2018 and had prevented him having contact with her children Archie, 7, and Lilibet, 5 to protect them. She has been out of contact with her father since the run-up to her 2018 wedding. Days before the event, Thomas Markle said he would not attend due to ill health after he earlier admitted posing for paparazzi pictures. Meghan said she was shown a letter which had been sent to British police in 2018 with "troubling and disturbing" allegations about her father, adding that she was told they were being investigated. British police did not immediately respond to a request for comment. "I am deeply distressed at the news that has come to light in the last 24 hours, and my thoughts are with any children who may have been harmed," she said. "My sincerest hope is that justice will be fully served and that the priority remains the safety and protection of innocent children," she added. The Sun also said Thomas Markle's son had contacted the FBI in the United States over the allegations. The FBI did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. [USN:L1N4610G2 TEXT:"Harry and Meghan"] and their children relocated to England in August after living in California for six years.

item.title: Austria expulsa a cuatro diplomáticos rusos por motivos de seguridad
item.description: El Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores de Austria anunció el viernes la expulsión de cuatro diplomáticos rusos destinados en Viena por "actividades incompatibles con su estatuto diplomático", un término que suele utilizarse para referirse al espionaje.
item.dc:creator: Francois Murphy
item.content:encoded: El Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores de Austria anunció el viernes la expulsión de cuatro diplomáticos rusos destinados en Viena por "actividades incompatibles con su estatuto diplomático", un término que suele utilizarse para referirse al espionaje. "A la luz de las conclusiones de las autoridades de seguridad austriacas, el Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores de Austria ha tomado medidas contra cuatro diplomáticos rusos en Viena", señaló en un comunicado, añadiendo que fueron declaradas personas non gratas y se les ordenó abandonar el país. Tres de ellos trabajaban en la embajada de Rusia en Austria y uno en la delegación rusa ante la Organización para la Seguridad y la Cooperación en Europa (OSCE) en materia de seguridad militar y control de armamento, según informó el ministerio. Con esta medida, asciende a 18 el número de diplomáticos rusos que Austria ha expulsado desde 2020. Aunque Austria es un país neutral, políticamente sus gobiernos se han posicionado del lado de Ucrania desde que Rusia lanzara su invasión a gran escala en 2022. "Viena está siguiendo sin reflexionar la política antirrusa de Occidente, e inevitablemente habrá una respuesta adecuada a tales medidas", afirmó la embajada rusa en un comunicado publicado en su página web, en el que calificó las expulsiones como "un nuevo paso hostil" hacia Rusia por parte de las autoridades austriacas. Aunque Austria no suele comentar los detalles de este tipo de expulsiones, durante la última ronda, en mayo, cuando expulsó a tres diplomáticos rusos, alegó que se debía a un "bosque de antenas" en los tejados de los edificios diplomáticos rusos que podrían utilizarse para espiar. Viena es un importante centro diplomático, sede de la OSCE y de organizaciones de las Naciones Unidas como el Organismo Internacional de Energía Atómica. Los países más grandes, como Rusia y Estados Unidos, suelen tener embajadores distintos para Austria, la OSCE y las organizaciones de la ONU, cada uno de los cuales dirige una embajada o misión. Viena, que quedó dividida en sectores aliados tras la Segunda Guerra Mundial, tiene desde hace tiempo fama de ser un nido de espías. La gran presencia diplomática ofrece la oportunidad de destinar allí a agentes de inteligencia al amparo de la inmunidad diplomática.

item.content:encoded: Frankreich mobilisiert für Samstag landesweit 70.000 Sicherheitskräfte, um Ausschreitungen bei den geplanten Protesten zu verhindern. Das teilte Innenminister Laurent Nunez am Freitag mit. Dabei verwies er auf Aufrufe zu Plünderungen und Gewalt aus der linksextremen Szene. "Sehen Sie sich die sozialen Medien an: Es gibt Aufrufe von ganz links, öffentliche Gebäude ins Visier zu nehmen. Wir sprechen hier nicht von einer friedlichen Demonstration", sagte Nunez vor Journalisten. "Wir sind morgen bereit, äußerst konsequent durchzugreifen und nichts zu tolerieren." Behörden, Geschäfte und Kultureinrichtungen rüsten sich trotz der angekündigten Einschränkungen für ein unruhiges Wochenende. In Paris kündigten unter anderem das Kunstmuseum Louvre und die Fondation Louis Vuitton nach den gewaltsamen Protesten der Vorwoche an, am Samstag nicht zu öffnen. Die Kunstmesse Art Basel Paris bleibt am gesamten Wochenende geschlossen. Die größte studentische Gewerkschaft Unef rief für Samstag zu Kundgebungen auf. Zudem plant die "Gelbwesten"-Bewegung einen Marsch durch das Zentrum der Hauptstadt. Präsident Emmanuel Macron hatte am Donnerstag angekündigt, nicht genehmigte Demonstrationen auflösen zu lassen. GEWERKSCHAFT: VERBOTE SIND KONTRAPRODUKTIV Macron wollte sich am Freitag mit Studentenvertretern treffen. Die Unef erklärte, an den Protesten gegen Lehrermangel und marode Schulen festzuhalten. Die Generalsekretärin der Gewerkschaft CFDT, Marylise Leon, sagte dem Sender TF1, die Einschränkung des Demonstrationsrechts sei kontraproduktiv. Die Behörden in Marseille und Lyon verboten alle für Samstag geplanten Kundgebungen. Unterdessen stellt sich die Stadt Orleans im Zentrum des Landes auf Unruhen ein. Dort ist ein Treffen der rechtspopulistischen Partei Rassemblement National geplant, gegen das Demonstrationen angekündigt sind. Seit vergangenem Samstag wurden dem Justizminister zufolge rund 2700 Menschen festgenommen. Die Proteste richten sich gegen Kürzungen im Haushalt. Darüber hinaus fordern die Demonstranten höhere Löhne angesichts gestiegener Lebenshaltungskosten. Die Regierung verweist dagegen auf die Notwendigkeit, die Staatsausgaben zu begrenzen, um die Kreditkosten zu kontrollieren. Die Risikoaufschläge für französische Staatsanleihen im Vergleich zu deutschen Bundesanleihen stiegen am Donnerstag auf den höchsten Stand seit 15 Jahren. Eine Entscheidung der Ratingagentur Moody's zur Kreditwürdigkeit Frankreichs wird am späten Freitagabend erwartet.

item.title: Agricultores franceses intensifican siembra de trigo y cebada antes de periodo de lluvias
item.description: La siembra de trigo blando y cebada de invierno en Francia se aceleró la semana pasada, según datos de la agencia agrícola FranceAgriMer, ya que los agricultores se apresuraron a terminar las labores del campo antes de que llegue el tiempo lluvioso de esta semana.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La siembra de trigo blando y cebada de invierno en Francia se aceleró la semana pasada, según datos de la agencia agrícola FranceAgriMer, ya que los agricultores se apresuraron a terminar las labores del campo antes de que llegue el tiempo lluvioso de esta semana. Francia, el mayor productor de cereales de la Unión Europea, ha sufrido una grave sequía desde el verano boreal, lo que ha suscitado la preocupación de que la siembra de otoño pudiera verse afectada tras una pésima cosecha de maíz. En un informe semanal publicado el viernes, FranceAgriMer estimó que, a 19 de octubre, se había sembrado el 45% de la superficie prevista para la cosecha de trigo blando del próximo año. Esta cifra supone un aumento respecto al 15% de la semana anterior y supera el promedio del 42% registrado en la misma semana de los últimos cinco años. En cuanto a la cebada de invierno, la siembra se había completado en un 55%, frente al 20% de la semana anterior y a un promedio de cinco años del 59%. El tiempo inestable de esta semana ha traído las primeras precipitaciones importantes en meses a algunas zonas de Francia, incluidas las principales cuencas cerealistas del norte. Este periodo de lluvias podría ralentizar las labores de siembra, pero ayudará a que broten los cultivos ya plantados, al tiempo que repone las reservas de humedad del suelo. En cuanto al maíz, cuya producción, según las previsiones generalizadas, se desplomará este año hasta alcanzar su nivel más bajo en 50 años tras la sequía y las olas de calor récord de este verano en el hemisferio norte, la cosecha estaba llegando a su fin. Según FranceAgriMer, el lunes los agricultores habían cosechado el 97% de la cosecha de maíz en grano.

item.title: Ein Toter bei Schießerei nahe Paris
item.description: Bei einer Schießerei im Departement Yvelines westlich von Paris ist ein Mensch getötet worden. Mindestens vier weitere Personen wurden verletzt, wie der französische Premierminister Sebastien Lecornu am Freitag mitteilte. Ein Verdächtiger wurde festgenommen.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bei einer Schießerei im Departement Yvelines westlich von Paris ist ein Mensch getötet worden. Mindestens vier weitere Personen wurden verletzt, wie der französische Premierminister Sebastien Lecornu am Freitag mitteilte. Ein Verdächtiger wurde festgenommen. Der Bürgermeister der Gemeinde Trappes, Ali Rabeh, sagte dem Fernsehsender BFMTV, ein Mann habe aus seinem Auto heraus geschossen. Der Angreifer habe "offenbar wahllos das Feuer eröffnet und wollte offenbar ein Massaker anrichten". Unter den Verletzten befindet sich demnach auch ein zwölfjähriges Mädchen. Der Schütze wohne in einer nahegelegenen Stadt. Über seine Motive gab es zunächst keine Informationen. Lecornu erklärte auf der Plattform X, die Sicherheitskräfte seien vollständig mobilisiert worden. "Die nationale Anti-Terror-Staatsanwaltschaft hat angekündigt, dass sie die Lage beobachtet", fügte er hinzu. Die Staatsanwaltschaft bestätigte, den Fall zu prüfen. Die zuständige Präfektur lehnte eine Stellungnahme ab.

item.content:encoded: Angesichts der hartnäckigen Inflation hält die russische Notenbank den Leitzins hoch. Der geldpolitische Schlüsselsatz verharrt bei 14,0 Prozent, wie die Zentralbank am Freitag in Moskau mitteilte. Von Reuters befragte Experten hatten damit gerechnet. Die Zentralbank hatte die Zinsen auch im September nicht angetastet – und dies nach einer Reihe von Senkungen seit Juni 2025. Mit der erneuten Pause schiebt die Notenbank eine Lockerung auf die lange Bank, mit der die nahezu stagnierende Konjunktur im fünften Jahr des Waffengangs gegen die Ukraine belebt werden könnte. Doch muss sie nicht nur die Wirtschaftsflaute im Auge halten, sondern auch den Preisauftrieb in Schach halten. "Der aktuelle Preisdruck bleibt hoch. Die Inflationserwartungen verharren auf einem hohen Niveau", konstatierte die Notenbank. In ihrem Basisszenario geht sie davon aus, dass der Leitzins noch sinken wird. Für 2027 veranschlagt sie im Durchschnitt ein Niveau von 12,5 bis 13,5 Prozent. Zugleich soll die Inflation im kommenden Jahr wieder 4,0 Prozent erreichen und auch in der Folgezeit auf diesem Zielwert der Zentralbank verharren. Für 2026 erhöhte sie ihre Inflationsprognose auf 7,1 bis 7,6 Prozent. Die Inflationsrate lag nach Regierungsangaben zuletzt bei 7,22 Prozent, nach einer Teuerungsrate von 6,35 Prozent im September. Dieser Anstieg sei auf Tariferhöhungen für Versorgungsleistungen zurückzuführen. Als weiterer Grund für den Inflationsschub gelten ukrainische Drohnenangriffe, die zu Engpässen und Preissteigerungen beim Sprit führten. Seit Beginn des Jahres haben sich Benzin um 21 Prozent und Diesel um 13,4 Prozent verteuert. Ukrainische Drohnenangriffe, von der Zentralbank als "Einmaleffekte" bezeichnet, haben in Russland zahlreiche Raffinerien getroffen und zu Warteschlangen an Tankstellen geführt.

item.title: Mercado de remédios para perda de peso no Brasil, Índia e China pode chegar a US$22 bi em 2035, diz J.P. Morgan
item.description: O mercado combinado de medicamentos para perda de peso na China, Índia e Brasil poderia crescer de US$6,6 bilhões atualmente para US$22 bilhões até 2035, segundo estimativas do J.P. Morgan, à medida que a maior acessibilidade financeira e o acesso mais amplo impulsionam a adoção desses medicamentos em populações de pacientes ainda amplamente inexploradas.
item.dc:creator: Joel Jose
item.content:encoded: O mercado combinado de medicamentos para perda de peso na China, Índia e Brasil poderia crescer de US$6,6 bilhões atualmente para US$22 bilhões até 2035, segundo estimativas do J.P. Morgan, à medida que a maior acessibilidade financeira e o acesso mais amplo impulsionam a adoção desses medicamentos em populações de pacientes ainda amplamente inexploradas. O mercado potencial poderia crescer a uma taxa anual de 15% até 2035, afirmaram analistas do J.P. Morgan, liderados por Yang Huang, em um relatório divulgado nesta sexta-feira, considerando o grande número de casos de diabetes e obesidade nesses países. Os medicamentos à base de GLP-1, como o Ozempic e o Wegovy, da Novo Nordisk (NOVOb.CO) , e o Zepbound, da Eli Lilly (LLY.N) , tornaram-se alguns dos remédios mais procurados para perda de peso e tratamento do diabetes em todo o mundo. A China e a Índia abrigam algumas das maiores populações de pacientes com diabetes do mundo, representando mais de 25% e 15% dos casos diagnosticados globalmente, respectivamente, enquanto cerca de 12% dos adultos brasileiros têm diabetes, de acordo com o J.P. Morgan. Os três países também enfrentam um fardo crescente de obesidade. A população com sobrepeso e obesa da China poderá ultrapassar 65% até 2030, enquanto a taxa de obesidade entre adultos na Índia deve atingir 11% até 2035. “O GLP-1 está passando de um tema de crescimento nos mercados desenvolvidos para uma história de acesso global mais ampla...”, afirmaram os analistas. “Com o vencimento de patentes, o lançamento de genéricos e os cortes de preços impulsionados por políticas públicas, que agora estão melhorando a acessibilidade do GLP-1, os três mercados estão convergindo para o mesmo destino.” MERCADOS INEXPLORADOS A adoção do GLP-1 em muitos mercados emergentes permaneceu baixa devido a preocupações com a acessibilidade. A penetração está abaixo de 0,1% na China e inferior a 0,2% na Índia, contra 4% a 5% nos EUA, de acordo com a nota. Embora o Brasil seja atualmente o maior dos três mercados, projeta-se que a penetração dos medicamentos para obesidade alcance apenas 7% a 8% de sua população obesa até 2035, em comparação com cerca de 30% nos EUA. O J.P. Morgan espera que a China ultrapasse o Brasil até 2027, com seu mercado atingindo US$13,7 bilhões até 2035, contra US$8 bilhões para o Brasil, impulsionado pela elevada incidência de diabetes e pelo reembolso mais amplo para terapias com GLP-1. Para a Índia, o menor dos três mercados, atitudes conservadoras em relação aos medicamentos GLP-1, juntamente com preocupações com a acessibilidade financeira, continuam sendo as principais barreiras à adoção, afirmou o J.P. Morgan, já que persistem a hesitação em relação aos injetáveis e atitudes culturais que mudam lentamente. A corretora destacou a Innovent (1801.HK) , da China, a Divi’s Laboratories (DIVI.NS) e a Torrent Pharmaceuticals (TORP.NS) , da Índia, além da RD Saúde (RADL3.SA) , do Brasil, como suas principais ações para aproveitar o tema de crescimento do GLP-1. (Reportagem de Joel Jose, em Bengaluru)

item.title: Los trabajadores de Volkswagen amenazan con huelgas si no se restablecen los acuerdos salariales
item.description: Los trabajadores de Volkswagen amenazaron el viernes con convocar huelgas a partir de enero a menos que el principal fabricante de automóviles de Europa revierta la reciente anulación de los acuerdos salariales antes de que termine la próxima semana.
item.dc:creator: Christoph Steitz
item.content:encoded: Los trabajadores de Volkswagen amenazaron el viernes con convocar huelgas a partir de enero a menos que el principal fabricante de automóviles de Europa revierta la reciente anulación de los acuerdos salariales antes de que termine la próxima semana. El conflicto por los recortes previstos llegó a su punto álgido el mes pasado, cuando Volkswagen rescindió casi todos los acuerdos salariales con los trabajadores alemanes, dejando abiertas a la renegociación condiciones laborales de larga tradición, como la jornada laboral y la paga de vacaciones. Volkswagen tiene previsto [USN:L6N44W0NU TEXT:"recortar"] 100.000 puestos de trabajo y podría cerrar hasta cuatro plantas en Alemania en lo que sería su mayor reestructuración de la historia, ante la feroz competencia china, los miles de millones en costos arancelarios y la costosa transición hacia los vehículos eléctricos. "Damos a la empresa hasta finales de octubre para que retire este preaviso de rescisión", dijo el negociador jefe de IG Metall, Thorsten Gröger, en Hannover, donde los sindicatos y la dirección se están reuniendo para una nueva ronda de negociaciones. "De lo contrario, se pondrá en marcha un proceso a gran escala que, y quiero dejarlo claro, allanará el camino para la huelga en Volkswagen", añadió. Las medidas de fuerza suelen incluir huelgas, que están descartadas antes del 1 de enero en virtud de una tregua vigente. La dirección de Volkswagen "debería marcar claramente esta fecha en sus agendas", señaló Gröger. El sindicato acusa al fabricante de automóviles alemán de eludir los compromisos adquiridos en un acuerdo histórico a finales de 2024, mientras que Volkswagen afirma que está explorando todas las opciones disponibles para reducir costos y salvaguardar la competitividad. El comité de empresa de Volkswagen dijo el lunes que el directorio tiene previsto congelar los salarios de 660.000 empleados en todo el mundo hasta 2030. "Sabemos qué condiciones operativas han cambiado, pero también sabemos cuáles eran previsibles, y esperamos que el directorio mejor pagado de este país colabore con nosotros para encontrar una solución", dijo la presidenta del comité de empresa, Daniela Cavallo. Volkswagen no ha querido comentar las medidas específicas de recorte de gastos y reestructuración que podría adoptar en las negociaciones salariales alemanas, que deben comenzar a más tardar a principios de diciembre, aunque Gröger ha pedido que den comienzo el 24 de noviembre. Una opción podría ser la denominada empresa de transición, creada con el apoyo de la agencia federal de empleo para reciclar a los trabajadores y ayudarles a encontrar nuevos puestos de trabajo fuera de Volkswagen.

item.title: UAE shares extend losses on regional conflict fears
item.description: Stock markets in the United Arab Emirates fell on Friday, with Dubai leading the decline driven by losses in financial and real estate shares as Houthi strikes in Saudi heightened fears of a wider regional conflict.
item.dc:creator: Mohammad Edrees
item.content:encoded: Stock markets in the United Arab Emirates fell on Friday, with Dubai leading the decline driven by losses in financial and real estate shares as Houthi strikes in Saudi heightened fears of a wider regional conflict. Saudi Aramco (2222.SE) has told staff to evacuate its [USN:L6N4680R9 TEXT:"Dhahran headquarters"] and work remotely, six people with knowledge of the matter said on Thursday, a day after two people were killed in an attack on a nearby airport. Dubai's main index (.DFMGI) dropped 1.4% to a more than four-month low, weighed down by a 3.5% fall in top lender Emirates NBD Bank (ENBD.DU) and a 2.1% decline in blue-chip developer Emaar Properties (EMAR.DU) . Abu Dhabi's benchmark index (.FTFADGI) fell 1.2%, pressured by energy, real estate and banking stocks. Real estate giant Aldar Properties (ALDAR.AD) slipped 3.7%, while energy shipping firm Adnoc L&S (ADNOCLS.AD) decreased 3.9%. Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank (ADCB.AD) , the UAE's third-largest lender, fell 3.7%, despite reporting a 15% rise in third-quarter net profit to 3.56 billion dirhams [USN:L8N468174 TEXT:"($969.26 million"]).7 Separately, the UAE is investing an additional €15 billion ($16.81 billion) in Greece, the Abu Dhabi Media Office said on Thursday, building on an existing joint investment initiative. Dubai and Abu Dhabi indexes posted weekly losses of 2.3% and 2.2%, respectively, according to LSEG data. Oil prices, a key driver of Gulf financial markets, drifted higher on Friday as Houthi attacks raised concerns about further disruption to Middle East energy supplies. Brent crude rose 1.3% to $114.61 a barrel by 1148 GMT. ($1 = 3.6729 UAE dirham)

Here are some details: Bajaj Housing Finance said Kalani tendered his resignation in a letter on Thursday and will pursue opportunities outside the organization Kalani, who joined the Bajaj Group in 2003, worked at its auto and financial services units before becoming CFO of the housing finance business in 2018 The exit comes at a time when India's housing finance companies face tougher competition in the mortgage market, as banks can borrow at lower costs and offer cheaper home loans, putting pressure on lenders' profit margins. item.title: LVHM-owned watchmaker Zenith to cut jobs, shift upmarket, source says
item.description: LVMH-owned Swiss watchmaker Zenith has launched a consultation process that could see up to half of its Swiss workforce laid off as it shifts its focus to more profitable luxury watches, a person close to the company said.
item.dc:creator: Alessandro Parodi
item.content:encoded: LVMH-owned (LVMH.PA) Swiss watchmaker Zenith has launched a consultation process that could see up to half of its Swiss workforce laid off as it shifts its focus to more profitable luxury watches, a person close to the company said. Swiss watchmakers have struggled for years with weak demand from inflation-hit consumers and growing competition from smartwatches, with only the most expensive brands proving resilient. "A staff consultation process was initiated today concerning a proposed strategic repositioning of the Maison," Zenith said in a statement on Thursday, without giving further details. Under the plan, Zenith will focus on the high-end segment, drawing on its expertise in complex watch movements, the person said. The segment typically includes watches priced above 3,000 Swiss francs ($3,650). The company could cut up to 100 jobs at its Le Locle plant in Switzerland, around half the workforce there, as well as about 100 positions in international operations, including sales and marketing, the person added. LVMH did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Zenith is one of the smaller watch brands owned by the luxury group. LVMH's Watches and Jewellery division reported 2025 sales of €10.49 billion ($11.74 billion) and profit of €1.51 billion. ($1 = 0.8233 Swiss francs) ($1 = 0.8933 euros)

item.title: Asian Cup to move to even years under AFC governance reforms
item.description: The Asian Football Confederation approved sweeping changes to its statutes on Friday, including a decision to move the Asian Cup to even-numbered years from 2032 as part of efforts to align with FIFA's evolving international calendar.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Asian Football Confederation approved sweeping changes to its statutes on Friday, including a decision to move the Asian Cup to even-numbered years from 2032 as part of efforts to align with FIFA's evolving international calendar. The amendments were unanimously approved at an Extraordinary Congress in Tokyo and introduced measures designed to keep the AFC's electoral cycle in sync with its competitions calendar amid upcoming changes to FIFA's schedule. Under the new framework, the Asian Cup, traditionally staged in odd-numbered years, will switch to an even-year cycle beginning with the 2032 tournament. The next edition is set to take place from January to February 2027 in Saudi Arabia. The AFC said the move would ensure its leadership cycle remains aligned with the confederation's flagship national-team competition and allow its executive committee to retain oversight of the event during key stages of its organisation. "Your decision today reinforces our governance and ensures our regulations remain robust, transparent, and fit for purpose to guarantee continuity, enabling us to usher in a brighter and better future for Asian football," AFC President Shaikh Salman bin Ibrahim Al Khalifa, who is seeking a fourth term in office next year, told delegates. The AFC confirmed that elections for its leadership positions will still be held in 2027. However, under the new arrangements, those elected will take office on January 1, 2028, for a four-year term running through 2032. The current executive members will remain in place until the end of 2027.

item.title: Papa cancela viagem a Assis para se recuperar de cirurgia de câncer
item.description: O papa Leão 14 cancelou uma visita prevista para 27 de outubro à cidade italiana de Assis, a fim de evitar um voo de helicóptero enquanto se recupera de uma cirurgia de câncer de pulmão, informou o Vaticano nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O papa Leão 14 cancelou uma visita prevista para 27 de outubro à cidade italiana de Assis, a fim de evitar um voo de helicóptero enquanto se recupera de uma cirurgia de câncer de pulmão, informou o Vaticano nesta sexta-feira. O pontífice, de 71 anos, tomou a decisão seguindo recomendação médica, informou o Vaticano, enquanto um comunicado separado de seu cirurgião e médico pessoal indicou que um exame torácico revelou excelente progresso na recuperação. O papa passou por uma cirurgia em 13 de outubro, na qual foi removido o lobo inferior do pulmão direito, e recebeu o diagnóstico de adenocarcinoma pulmonar, a forma mais comum de câncer de pulmão. Os médicos do papa informaram na quarta-feira que exames adicionais do tecido removido na cirurgia confirmaram que o câncer era localizado e que ele não precisaria de nenhum tratamento oncológico contínuo. Leão 14 deveria viajar no dia 27 de outubro para Assis, a cerca de 175km ao norte de Roma, para um evento pela paz com outros líderes religiosos. “Para facilitar sua recuperação após a cirurgia torácica realizada na última terça-feira, e de acordo com as recomendações médicas, o papa Leão 14 não poderá comparecer”, informou o comunicado do Vaticano. Leão 14 recebeu alta do hospital no sábado e está retomando gradualmente suas funções normais. Na quarta-feira, ele voltou à Praça de São Pedro para sua audiência semanal com os peregrinos. O Vaticano não informou se o papa poderá realizar a viagem programada para os dias 6 a 17 de novembro ao Uruguai, à Argentina e ao Peru. (Reportagem de Joshua McElwee)

item.title: UK approves J&J's oral psoriasis pill
item.description: Britain's medicines regulator on Friday approved Johnson & Johnson's daily pill for adults and teenagers with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis, a skin condition causing red, scaly and often itchy or painful patches.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's medicines regulator on Friday approved Johnson & Johnson's (JNJ.N) daily pill for adults and teenagers with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis, a skin condition causing red, scaly and often itchy or painful patches. Here are some details: The Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) approved the oral drug Icotyde for people aged 12 and older who weigh at least 40 kg The approval was based on four late-stage trials in 2,500 people with the disease, including 72 teenagers aged 12 to under 18 In all four studies, patients who took the drug saw better results after 16 weeks than those given a placebo, the regulator said Icotyde was [USN:L4N4061MF TEXT:"approved in the US"] earlier this year for the same condition — its first approved indication The drug is made in collaboration with Protagonist Therapeutics (PTGX.O) J&J is also studying the drug, chemically known as icotrokinra, for ulcerative colitis, psoriatic arthritis and Crohn's disease The company expects the treatment to bring in $5 billion in peak sales across multiple indications The drug competes with established psoriasis treatments such as Bristol Myers Squibb's (BMY.N) Sotyktu and AbbVie's blockbuster (ABBV.N) Skyrizi

item.title: Brazil consumer prices rise 0.32% in mid-October
item.description: Brazil's IPCA-15 consumer price index rose 0.32% in the month to mid-October, down from 0.70% in the previous month, government statistics agency IBGE said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazil's IPCA-15 consumer price index rose 0.32% in the month to mid-October, down from 0.70% in the previous month, government statistics agency IBGE said on Friday. The index had been expected to rise 0.43%, according to the median forecast in a Reuters poll. Consumer prices rose 4.62% in the 12 months through mid-October, IBGE added, up from 4.47% in the previous month but below the 4.73% expected by economists in the Reuters poll.

item.title: Dr Reddy's beats quarterly profit estimate on India market lift
item.description: Indian drugmaker Dr Reddy's Laboratories reported a better-than-expected quarterly profit on Friday, as domestic demand helped cushion the slowdown in its key US market.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indian drugmaker Dr Reddy's Laboratories (REDY.NS) reported a better-than-expected quarterly profit on Friday, as domestic demand helped cushion the slowdown in its key US market. Consolidated net profit after tax fell to 9.25 billion rupees ($97.43 million) in the quarter ended September 30, from 13.47 billion rupees a year ago. Analysts, on average, had estimated a profit of 7.49 billion rupees, according to data compiled by LSEG. The company took a 710 million rupee revenue hit from a recall of semaglutide in Canada, adding to the 2.4 billion rupees in provisions it made in the previous quarter over quality issues with the drug. Dr Reddy's, which is counting on semaglutide as a major growth driver in India and a few global markets, said in July that supplies of its generic version would remain [USN:L4N43B09O TEXT:"unavailable"] in India and face disruptions in Canada until at least late October after an impurity issue in the active ingredient forced it to halt production of new batches. Revenue from operations fell 1.6% to 86.98 billion rupees, hit by pricing pressure and increasing competition in its key US market. Revenue from North America business fell about 23% to 24.89 billion rupees. Dr Reddy's has been grappling with declining sales of Lenalidomide, its generic version of Bristol Myers Squibb's (BMY.N) blockbuster cancer drug Revlimid, as more rivals enter the market after the drug lost exclusivity. Ongoing pricing pressure in generics is also adding to the slowdown. The Indian market remained a bright spot with revenue boosted by demand for chronic therapy drugs, while the company expanded into women's health with the acquisition of hormone replacement therapy brands. Revenue from the India business rose 17.2% to 18.5 billion rupees. Shares of the company closed marginally lower on Friday. They have dropped 3.3% so far this year, compared with the pharma index's (.NIPHARM) 12% climb. ($1 = 94.9400 Indian rupees)

item.title: Stellantis, Bolt et Grand Paris veulent lancer des services de mobilité autonome dès 2028
item.description: Stellantis , l'entreprise estonienne de VTC Bolt et la région Île-de-France prévoient de lancer un programme de conduite autonome dans la capitale française en 2028, en utilisant des véhicules du constructeur franco-italo-américain, ont-elles annoncé vendredi dans un communiqué commun.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Stellantis (STLAM.MI) , l'entreprise estonienne de VTC Bolt et la région Île-de-France prévoient de lancer un programme de conduite autonome dans la capitale française en 2028, en utilisant des véhicules du constructeur franco-italo-américain, ont-elles annoncé vendredi dans un communiqué commun. Ce programme pilote, soumis à l’initiative ADACities de la Commission européenne, permettra d'évaluer les lacunes des services de transport existants, dans le but de lancer une exploitation commerciale en Île-de-France d'ici 2030, ont précisé les trois parties. Les premiers déploiements sont prévus dans cinq communes du nord-ouest de la région parisienne. "Cette expérimentation contribuera également à éclairer la décision publique et définir les conditions d’un éventuel déploiement à plus grande échelle", a déclaré Patrick Ollier, président de la Métropole du Grand Paris. Le groupe chinois Pony.ai (PONY.O) , spécialisé dans les technologies de conduite autonome, est un fournisseur potentiel de cette technologie Stellantis et Bolt avait annoncé en décembre 2025 un [USN:FWN3XE1CA TEXT:"partenariat"] pour développer et déployer conjointement des véhicules autonomes de niveau 4 (sans conducteur) pour leurs activités commerciales en Europe.

item.title: Hyrox and Xenom aspire to make fitness 'largest sport on earth'
item.description: Global indoor fitness race company Hyrox is teaming up with new player Xenom to expand participation and maybe one day even be accepted into the Olympics, the companies' executives say.
item.dc:creator: Streisand Neto
item.content:encoded: Global indoor fitness race company Hyrox is teaming up with new player Xenom to expand participation and maybe one day even be accepted into the Olympics, the companies' executives say. Hyrox, founded in Hamburg, Germany, in 2017, and Xenom, a CrossFit-inspired platform founded in 2026, announced a strategic partnership earlier this month to work together on marketing, events and education. The founders of Hyrox, Olympic gold medallist Moritz Fuerste and entrepreneur Christian Toetzke, have invested in Xenom, the latter company said in its announcement, without giving any financial details. Their shared goal, it said, was "making fitness the largest sport on earth." Hyrox joins a board that includes US investment firm WndrCo founded by former Walt Disney Studios Chairman Jeffrey Katzenberg and former Dropbox CFO Sujay Jaswa, who led Xenom's $15 million seed round. “It made a lot of sense to us, the partnership. We exist in separate but connected markets on the same spectrum of fitness and we see a future where people will move around that spectrum," Xenom CEO Keith Barlow told Reuters. A Xenom competition involves athletes participating in 10 fixed standardised events across two days. That is similar to Hyrox's standard fixed eight-event format which combines running and functional workouts, offering participants four different racing categories. Mass-participation fitness events are increasingly popular. “We're planning to end up somewhere at 2.2 million participants for this running season. 2.5-ish for the calendar year (20)27,” Fuerste, a former German hockey player, told Reuters about Hyrox. FITNESS AT THE OLYMPICS? Xenom, which held its inaugural event Dallas, Texas, in June followed by an event in London, has seen early growth. “We had just over 400 athletes in Dallas and we had 560-ish in London. So about 30% growth on the first two events and then coming into Miami, we've got really high expectations,” Barlow said, as Xenom prepares for its Miami event in December and then its first full international season in 2027 opening in Malaga. As Hyrox continues to attract more participants across the world, so does its expansion ambitions. With over 100 events in cities including London and Rio de Janeiro, Fuerste wants to enlarge Hyrox’s footprint in Latin America. “I think probably South America is a region where we can grow. Apart from Argentina, Brazil, then middle America, Mexico. There is a little bit more room to grow there.” Hyrox would also love to see fitness become an Olympic discipline – possibly by Brisbane 2032. "That's the big goal and the aspiration that we have. And we are working on the technicalities behind that …. Is it super likely? I don't know,” said Fuerste.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der Bundesgerichtshof hat den in Brandenburg festgenommenen mutmaßlichen russischen Spion in Untersuchungshaft genommen. Der Haftbefehl gegen den ukrainischen Staatsangehörigen Vadym J. sei in Vollzug gesetzt worden, teilte der Generalbundesanwalt am Freitag in Karlsruhe mit. Der Beschuldigte steht im dringenden Verdacht, für einen russischen Nachrichtendienst militärisch relevante Informationen gesammelt zu haben. Den Ermittlern zufolge stand Vadym J. spätestens seit Juli 2025 über einen Mittelsmann in Kontakt mit einem russischen Nachrichtendienst. Vor dem Hintergrund des russischen Angriffskrieges gegen die Ukraine habe er von Deutschland aus Informationen beschafft. Dazu gehörten Erkenntnisse über die Produktion von Panzern, Munition und Explosivstoffen sowie über Personal und militärische Anlagen zur Sicherung der Nato-Ostflanke. Für einige der Informationen habe der Mann gezielt Personen aus der europäischen Rüstungsbranche abgeschöpft. Das Verteidigungsministerium erklärte, der Fall zeige die vielfältigen Bedrohungen für Deutschland und die Bundeswehr durch ausländische Nachrichtendienste. Insbesondere die Bundeswehr-Brigade in Litauen sei Ziel nachrichtendienstlicher Angriffe, sagte eine Sprecherin. Zum Schutz der Truppe sei dort zum 1. April eine eigene Stelle des Militärischen Abschirmdienstes (MAD) eingerichtet worden. Die Sprecherin betonte, der Schutzauftrag der Bundeswehr beziehe sich auf die Truppe und ihre Liegenschaften, nicht aber auf Rüstungsunternehmen. Ob die betroffenen Firmen gewarnt worden seien, wollte sie nicht sagen. Die Erkenntnisse zu dem Fall gingen ursprünglich auf das Bundesamt für Verfassungsschutz zurück. Mit den weiteren Ermittlungen ist das Bundeskriminalamt beauftragt.

item.title: China's Baidu tests robotaxi on London streets
item.description: US-based Lyft unit Freenow and Baidu's Apollo Go unveiled the Chinese company's RT6 autonomous vehicle in London on Thursday and said they hope to launch a driverless robotaxi service in the city in 2027.
item.dc:creator: Marissa Davison
item.content:encoded: US-based Lyft (LYFT.O) unit Freenow and Baidu's (9888.HK) Apollo Go unveiled the Chinese company's RT6 autonomous vehicle in London on Thursday and said they hope to launch a driverless robotaxi service in the city in 2027. The two companies began testing vehicles in London with safety drivers in the summer and hope to have fully driverless vehicles in the city next year, aiming for a commercial launch in 2027. The partnership between San Francisco-based ride-hailing firm Lyft and China's Baidu in London comes as the US Senate is working to pass a [USN:L1N45M132 TEXT:"permanent ban"] on Chinese cars in the United States, pushing more companies to focus on Europe. Competition between robotaxi developers in London is heating up. UK self-driving vehicle startup [USN:L8N44U25P TEXT:"Wayve"] and Lyft rival Uber (UBER.N) launched a robotaxi service in London in September, initially with a human safety driver behind the wheel. US robotaxi company Waymo, a unit of Google parent Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , aims to launch a [USN:L4N3YT1QZ TEXT:"fully driverless"] ride-hailing service in London by the end of this year. LONDON STREETS OFFER CHALLENGING TEST Freenow UK general manager Danny O'Gorman said London was a particularly good testing ground, with lots of speed bumps, narrow streets and many roads limited to 20 miles per hour. "So the car is going through the phase of learning the rules of the road much like you would do if you're trying to pass your own driving test," O'Gorman told Reuters during a demonstration ride. O'Gorman said the company was working closely with Transport for London and expected regulatory guidelines in the coming week. He recognised new technology "can sometimes be scary" but most Londoners were excited about the prospect He said robotaxis were not trying to replace London's famous black cabs. The firm is talking about "tens of vehicles in the next year or two" as it tests the market. "In terms of the taxi in London, the iconic black cab, this is not a replacement for that service," he said. "Black cabs are a fundamental part of London."

item.title: Czech government fast-tracks public media revamp criticised as power grab
item.description: The Czech ruling coalition moved on Friday to fast-track legislation that would move public media financing into the state budget and cut funding, a plan critics say threatens press independence.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Czech ruling coalition moved on Friday to fast-track legislation that would move public media financing into the state budget and cut funding, a plan critics say threatens press independence. The populist government, led by billionaire Andrej Babis and backed by a pro-Russian far-right party, has frequently attacked public and private media critical of its policies. The proposal, which had been flagged previously but was unexpectedly brought to a first parliamentary reading on Friday, would cut funding for Czech Television and Czech Radio by about 15%, possibly during next year. It would also scrap the licence fee system under which households pay 205 crowns ($9.44) a month and instead finance the broadcasters through the state budget. Critics say the changes would weaken the broadcasters and leave them more vulnerable to political influence. Czech Television is the country's most-watched broadcaster across the main age groups. In another unusual move, the lower house voted to extend debate, the first of three required readings, into Saturday in a bid to overcome opposition obstruction. Zdenek Hrib, leader of the opposition Pirate Party, likened the government's behaviour to Hungary under former prime minister Viktor Orban, whose rule was marked by disputes over media freedom and the rule of law. "We are seeing here that Andrej Babis and his entourage... have embarked on the trajectory of installing an authoritarian regime," Hrib said in the opening debate in parliament. GOVERNMENT SAYS PLAN FOLLOWS EUROPEAN TREND ANO, the leading party in the coalition, pledged before last year's election to abolish licence fees so households would no longer pay directly for public broadcasting. "The government is led to this change by a European trend under which ever more European countries depart from the fee-funded principle," the proposal submitted to parliament said. The government has argued that savings are needed at the broadcasters and that the changes would not affect editorial coverage. The move sits uneasily with the government's efforts to curb budget deficits. The 2027 budget projects a wider deficit but makes no provision for public media funding. Journalists and media organisations see the changes as an attempt to increase political control over coverage. They say the proposals have not been subjected to sufficient public debate, lack safeguards against political interference and would make funding more dependent on politicians. Reporters Without Borders, the International Press Institute and the European Broadcasting Union are among the organisations that have criticised the plan. ($1 = 21.7240 Czech crowns)

item.title: AmEx relève son objectif de bénéfice grâce aux dépenses de sa clientèle aisée
item.description: American Express (AmEx) a relevé vendredi son objectif de bénéfice pour 2026 après avoir publié de solides résultats au troisième trimestre de son exercice, tirés, une fois de plus, par les dépenses des clients fortunés.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: American Express (AmEx) (AXP.N) a relevé vendredi son objectif de bénéfice pour 2026 après avoir publié de solides résultats au troisième trimestre de son exercice, tirés, une fois de plus, par les dépenses des clients fortunés. En ciblant les consommateurs disposant d’une excellente solvabilité et d’un revenu disponible plus élevé, le géant des cartes de crédit s’est forgé un rempart autour de son activité afin de se prémunir contre les ralentissements économiques généraux et l’incertitude. Le chiffre d’affaires facturé, qui mesure le total des dépenses effectuées avec toutes les cartes émises, a augmenté de 8% au troisième trimestre pour atteindre 454 milliards de dollars (405,61 milliards d'euros). Le chiffre d’affaires a grimpé de 9% pour s’établir à 20,1 milliards de dollars. "La dynamique commerciale se poursuit, avec des résultats solides en termes de chiffre d’affaires, de nouvelles acquisitions et de fidélisation des titulaires de cartes, ainsi qu’une excellente qualité de crédit", a déclaré Stephen Squeri, directeur général d’AmEx, dans un communiqué. Le groupe prévoit désormais un bénéfice annuel compris entre 18,30 et 18,60 dollars par action, contre une fourchette antérieure comprise entre 17,30 et 17,90 dollars. Le bénéfice ajusté d’AmEx a atteint 4,68 dollars par action au cours du trimestre clos le 30 septembre, contre 4,14 dollars un an plus tôt. Le bénéfice ajusté d’AmEx a atteint 4,68 dollars par action au cours du trimestre clos le 30 septembre, contre 4,14 dollars un an plus tôt. Bien que ces résultats ne constituent pas un indicateur exhaustif de la santé des consommateurs, ils offrent un aperçu précoce des habitudes de consommation des plus aisés, donnant ainsi aux investisseurs un éclairage sur les tendances en matière de dépenses discrétionnaires. AmEx a constitué un milliard de dollars de provisions consolidées pour pertes sur créances au cours du trimestre, contre 1,3 milliard de dollars à la même période de l’année précédente. Le titre du groupe prenait environ 1% dans les échanges avant-Bourse.

item.title: POINT MARCHÉS Wall Street vue en baisse, l'Europe dans le rouge entre résultats, pétrole et dette française
item.description: Wall Street est attendue baisse et les Bourses européennes reculent vendredi à mi-séance, la confiance des investisseurs restant plombée par les craintes budgétaires en France et par la flambée des prix du pétrole, tandis que la dernière vague de résultats d'entreprises entraîne de lourdes pertes pour certains grands noms de la cote tels que Kering, Safran ou Volvo Cars.
item.dc:creator: Diana Mandia
item.content:encoded: Wall Street est attendue baisse et les Bourses européennes reculent vendredi à mi-séance, la confiance des investisseurs restant plombée par les craintes budgétaires en France et par la flambée des prix du pétrole, tandis que la dernière vague de résultats d'entreprises entraîne de lourdes pertes pour certains grands noms de la cote tels que Kering, Safran ou Volvo Cars. Les futures sur indices new-yorkais signalent une ouverture de Wall Street en baisse de 0,6% pour le Dow Jones (.DJI) , de 0,27% pour le Standard & Poor's-500 (.SPX) et de 0,14% pour le Nasdaq. Ce dernier vient de connaître un plongeon de de 2,6% la veille, sa plus forte baisse depuis juin, dans un contexte de ventes massives dans le secteur de l'intelligence artificielle (IA). À Paris, le CAC 40 (.FCHI) perd 0,58% à 7.765,91 points vers 11h29 GMT. À Francfort, le Dax (.GDAXI) recule de 0,71% et à Londres, le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) cède 0,48%. L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) cède 0,54%, le FTSEurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) 0,48% et le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) 0,47%. L'aversion au risque reste élevée en cette dernière séance de la semaine et devrait entraîner d'importantes pertes hebdomadaires pour les principaux indices européens, des secteurs clés tels que le luxe (-2,55%) ou la défense (-3,59%) étant à la peine après la publication de chiffres financiers qui n'ont pas été bien accueillis. La saison des résultats bat son plein et, paradoxalement, les analystes se montrent plutôt optimistes quant au bilan qui en ressortira, les bénéfices trimestriels des entreprises de l'indice STOXX 600 devant progresser de 21,9%, soit le deuxième meilleur taux de croissance des quatre dernières années, principalement grâce aux entreprises du secteur de l'énergie, selon les données de LSEG I/B/E/S. Mais les Bourses détournent le regard vers un contexte général peu favorable. Les importantes manifestations du week-end dernier contre la vie chère en France, qui ont dégénéré en émeutes et en pillages, renforcent encore davantage les doutes quant à l'avenir du projet de budget actuellement débattu à l'Assemblée nationale, dans un climat tendu également alimenté par la proximité de l'élection présidentielle de l'année prochaine. La deuxième économie de la zone euro peine à réduire son déficit, ce qui a contribué à amplifier cette semaine la prime de risque de la dette publique française par rapport aux obligations allemandes à son plus haut niveau depuis 15 ans, tandis que le rendement de l'OAT à 10 ans a touché jeudi un pic despuis juillet 2002, à 5,14%. Si le rendement recule vendredi, il évolue toujours au-dessus de la barre symbolique des 5%, et la tension reste forte, de nouvelles mobilisations étant prévues samedi — malgré une avalanche d'interdictions de manifester de la part des préfets visant à limiter le risque de troubles —, tandis que Moody's pourrait abaisser la note de crédit de la France dans la soirée, emboîtant ainsi le pas aux agences de notation qui l'on déjà fait. Les indicateurs économiques reflètent déjà les effets de ce climat de plus en plus morose: la croissance du secteur privé de la zone euro a ralenti en octobre pour atteindre son plus faible rythme depuis juin, sous l'effet d'une hausse des coûts liée à l'énergie et d'une nouvelle contraction en France, selon [USN:ZRN00EPDP TEXT:"l'enquête PMI"] préliminaire publiée vendredi. Le resserrement des conditions de financement en cours déterminera probablement le ton des réunions des banques centrales prévues dès la semaine prochaine, notamment celles de la Réserve fédérale (Fed) et de la Banque centrale européenne (BCE), qui, selon les opérateurs, maintiendront leurs taux inchangés avant de les relever à nouveau en décembre. "Les deux banques centrales doivent mettre en balance les pressions inflationnistes liées à l'énergie, d'une part, et le durcissement des conditions financières, d'autre part", écrivent dans une note les analystes de la banque privée suisse J. Safra Sarasin. LES VALEURS À SUIVRE À WALL STREET [USN:L8N4690O9] VALEURS EN EUROPE L'action [USN:S8N465039 TEXT:"Kering"] (PRTP.PA) dévisse de plus de 13% au lendemain des résultats trimestriels du géant français du luxe, marqués par une baisse des ventes de Gucci, sa marque phare, dans un contexte de faiblesse persistante de la fréquentation de ses magasins. Le secteur du luxe sur le Stoxx 600 (.STXLUXP) recule de 2,55% dans son sillage. [USN:L8N4682D0 TEXT:"L'Oréal"] (OREP.PA) est en revanche en nette hausse (+5,2%) après avoir publié une croissance des ventes trimestrielles supérieure aux attentes, soulignant sa résilience dans un contexte de ralentissement du reste du secteur. À Paris également, [USN:L8N4690JV TEXT:"Safran"] (SAF.PA) perd 8,3%, les investisseurs craignant que le ralentissement de la croissance des ventes sur le marché des pièces de rechange ne se prolonge jusqu'en 2027, avec des compagnies aériennes qui réduisent leurs capacités face à la hausse des prix du carburant. Le groupe de restauration collective [USN:L8N46908A TEXT:"Sodexo"] (EXHO.PA) grimpe quant à lui de 6,4% après avoir publié un chiffre d'affaires annuel plus important que prévu. Ailleurs en Europe, [USN:L8N4690A6 TEXT:"Volvo Cars"] (VOLCARb.ST) dégringole de 26%, le groupe suédois ayant publié une perte d'exploitation au troisième trimestre et annoncé la suppression de 2.500 emplois pour réduire ses coûts face à la concurrence chinoise. TAUX Les rendements des obligations américaines progressent vendredi, mais cette hausse intervient après leur plus fort recul depuis plus de trois ans la veille : les turbulences qui secouent le secteur technologique ont redonné aux titres du Trésor leur statut de valeur refuge, ce qui a permis au rendement de l'obligation à dix ans de repasser sous la barre des 5%. Le rendement des Treasuries à dix ans gagne 4,4 points de base à 4,9966%, tandis que celui du titre à deux ans avance de 6 points de base à 4,6946%. Dans la zone euro, le rendement du Bund allemand à dix ans est plutôt stable à 3,3435%. Le deux ans gagne 1,8 point de base à 3,0319%. En France, le rendement de l'OAT à dix ans perd 3,6 points de base à 5,0536%, le mouvement de vente de dette souveraine française se calmant légèrement après deux séances de fortes tensions. CHANGES Le dollar gagne 0,18% face à un panier de devises de référence (.DXY) mais s'achemine vers une baisse hebdomadaire, la devise américaine, au contraire du yen japonais, ne parvenant pas à tirer parti de la recherche de valeurs refuges par les investisseurs. Les incertitudes concernant le secteur de l'IA pourrait conduire la Fed à une politique monétaire moins restrictive que prévu, un scénario qui a pesé sur le billet vert. L'euro perd pour sa part 0,16% et ressort à 1,1196 dollar . PÉTROLE Les cours pétroliers progressent encore et évoluent autour de leur plus haut niveau depuis plus de cinq mois, les attaques des Houthis en Arabie saoudite ayant ravivé les craintes d'une nouvelle perturbation des approvisionnements énergétiques en provenance du Moyen-Orient. Le Brent prend 1,33% à 114,67 dollars le baril et le brut léger américain (West Texas Intermediate, WTI) gagne 1,62% à 101,08 dollars. Le gain mensuel du Brent dépasse les 10%, tandis que les prix du gaz naturel en Europe progressent de près de 30% depuis début octobre. item.title: Bristol Myers, SystImmune breast cancer drug cuts progression risk in study
item.description: Bristol Myers Squibb and partner SystImmune said on Friday their experimental breast cancer treatment slowed disease progression compared to standard chemotherapy in a late-stage study.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY.N) and partner SystImmune said on Friday their experimental breast cancer treatment slowed disease progression compared to standard chemotherapy in a late-stage study. The drug, izalontamab brengitecan, reduced the risk of disease worsening or death by 59% in patients with advanced hormone-receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer — the most common form of breast cancer — who had failed at least one prior line of chemotherapy. Izalontamab brengitecan belongs to a class of treatments known as antibody-drug conjugates, often called "guided missiles". It targets two specific proteins, EGFR and HER3, to deliver a cancer-killing payload directly to tumor cells. In the study, which enrolled 383 patients, those treated with the drug lived for a median of 8.2 months without their cancer growing, compared to four months for the participants on standard chemotherapy. About 40.5% of patients on iza-bren saw their tumors shrink, compared to 20.2% on chemotherapy. The response lasted a median of 6.9 months, versus 4.2 months for chemotherapy. Data on overall survival, how long patients lived in total, was not yet mature at the time of the interim analysis. The full results will be presented at the European Society for Medical Oncology congress in Madrid. Bristol Myers had partnered with SystImmune, a unit of Chinese drugmaker Sichuan Biokin Pharmaceutical, in an [USN:L4N3D63QM TEXT:"up to $8.4 billion"] deal announced in 2023 to develop and commercialize the drug outside mainland China. Its side effects were manageable and no new safety concerns emerged, Bristol Myers said. Only 1.6% of patients stopped treatment because of side effects, while two patients developed mild-to-moderate lung inflammation.

item.title: Russian ESPO oil sellers seek record premiums as Gulf exports uncertain
item.description: Russian oil sellers have raised ESPO Blend offers to China to record levels, supported by strong demand and higher freight costs driven by the Iran war, although some independent Chinese refiners may baulk as margins turn negative, traders said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russian oil sellers have raised ESPO Blend offers to China to record levels, supported by strong demand and higher freight costs driven by the Iran war, although some independent Chinese refiners may baulk as margins turn negative, traders said. Far East ESPO Blend cargoes for end-December and January delivery have been offered at premiums above $25 a barrel to ICE Brent, with two offers heard above $30 a barrel delivered to China, traders said. November and December cargoes were offered at premiums of $26-$27 a barrel, with a few remaining unsold, another trader said. Some market participants said sellers were testing buyers' appetite with the hefty offers amid disruptions to Middle East exports. US President Donald Trump's announcement last Friday of a [USN:L6N464042 TEXT:"waiver"] on key sanctions against Russia also supported demand expectations, although details remain unclear, two traders said. Russian oil has become more expensive for Asian buyers because it is priced against Brent, while most Middle East grades are linked to Dubai. Brent typically trades at a premium to Dubai, and that gap has widened. The Brent-Dubai spread settled at $5.05 a barrel on Thursday. Oil prices [USN:L1N46903W TEXT:"rose"] on Friday, with Brent crude touching a more than five-month high of nearly $115 a barrel, after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked concern over further disruption to energy supplies from the Middle East. Two traders said Chinese refiners were still willing to pay premiums of $20 a barrel for ESPO Blend, but not the latest record high offer levels. However, one recent deal by a large independent Chinese refiner for November and December cargoes was heard at premiums of $23-$26 a barrel to ICE Brent, a senior Chinese trader said, adding that smaller plants would lose money at those levels. That compared with $12 premiums for November shipments [USN:L1N4520CP TEXT:"Reuters reported in September"]. ELEVATED FREIGHT RATES Russian sellers say elevated freight rates have driven up ESPO prices and should be reflected in premiums. Aframax tanker rates from Kozmino to China briefly surged to $10 million per voyage in October before falling to about $2 million, a decline that could eventually pressure ESPO premiums lower, traders said. Russian Urals oil prices recently [USN:L6N46014O TEXT:"weakened"] to parity with dated Brent and small discounts to the benchmark in some cases as top Asian clients - Indian refiners - were not able to pay such high prices and turned to alternatives.
